A company breached a long-term loan agreement before its reporting date of 31 December 2022, making the loan payable on demand. On 10 January 2023, before the financial statements were authorized, the lender agreed not to demand immediate payment. How should this loan be classified as at 31 December 2022?

Joe Co buys 100 T-shirts in January for N3.50 each in cash. During January, 30 T-shirts are sold for cash at N7.00 each. What is the profit or loss for January under the Accrual Basis and Cash Basis respectively?
options: Accrual: Profit N105; Cash: Loss N140
Accrual: Profit N105; Cash: Profit N210
Accrual: Profit N350; Cash: Loss N140
Accrual: Loss N105; Cash: Loss N350
quizzes.correct_answer: Accrual: Profit N105; Cash: Loss N140

quizzes.question: A company facing liquidation prepares its financial statements on a break-up basis. It owns a building carried at N1,500,000, but real estate professionals advise it can only be sold for N1,200,000. How should this asset be classified and valued?
Under Chapter 2 of the IASB Conceptual Framework, which two features are identified as the Fundamental Qualitative Characteristics of useful financial information?

MCPAPA Ltd sells goods to Bola Ltd for N10,000, committing to repurchase them in 12 months for N11,000. Applying the principle of substance over legal form, how should MCPAPA Ltd record this transaction initially?
options: Record a sale of N10,000 and derecognize the goods from inventory
Retain the goods in inventory and recognize a financial liability of N10,000
Record a purchase of N11,000 immediately
Disclose as a contingent asset of N1,000 in the notes
quizzes.correct_answer: Retain the goods in inventory and recognize a financial liability of N10,000

quizzes.question: According to the IASB Conceptual Framework, a perfectly faithful representation possesses which three characteristics?
options: Complete, Neutral, and Free from error
quizzes.correct_answer: Complete, Neutral, and Free from error

quizzes.question: How is 'Value in Use' defined under current value measurement bases in the Conceptual Framework?
options: The price that would be received to sell an asset in an orderly transaction between market participants
The amount of cash or cash equivalents that would have to be paid if the same asset was acquired currently
The present value of cash flows or other economic benefits an entity expects to derive from the use of an asset and its ultimate disposal
The undiscounted amount of cash required to settle an obligation currently
quizzes.correct_answer: The present value of cash flows or other economic benefits an entity expects to derive from the use of an asset and its ultimate disposal

quizzes.question: Which of the following items is required to be recognized in Other Comprehensive Income (OCI) rather than Profit or Loss?
options: Write-downs of inventories to net realizable value
Gains and losses arising from translating the financial statements of a foreign operation
Restructurings of the activities of an entity
quizzes.correct_answer: Gains and losses arising from translating the financial statements of a foreign operation

quizzes.question: Which of the following is a legal requirement in Nigeria regarding annual published financial statements of registered companies under CAMA?
options: They must be published in at least 2 national daily newspapers and signed by a director with an FRC registration number
They must be prepared strictly in accordance with US GAAP
Unincorporated entities are completely exempt from all legislation, including the Charities Act
Small private limited companies must publish quarterly financial statements
quizzes.correct_answer: They must be published in at least 2 national daily newspapers and signed by a director with an FRC registration number

quizzes.question: Under the concept of Physical Capital Maintenance, profit is earned only if:
options: The monetary capital at the end of the period exceeds opening monetary capital
The physical productive capacity at the end of the period exceeds the physical productive capacity at the start of the period
Closing equity adjusted by a general price index exceeds opening equity
quizzes.correct_answer: The physical productive capacity at the end of the period exceeds the physical productive capacity at the start of the period

quizzes.question: Which group of financial statement users requires information primarily to assess whether loans and related interest will be paid when due, and whether financial restrictions have been breached?
Derecognition of a financial asset from an entity's Statement of Financial Position normally occurs when:
options: The entity loses control of all or part of the recognized asset
The entity changes its accounting policy from cost model to revaluation model
The asset's carrying value reaches zero
quizzes.correct_answer: The entity loses control of all or part of the recognized asset

quizzes.question: When an entity categorizes its expenses by function (Cost of Sales method), what minimum disclosures regarding the nature of expenses must be provided in the notes?
options: Raw materials, transport costs, and legal fees
Depreciation, amortization, and employee benefits expense
Sales commission, audit fees, and rent expense
quizzes.correct_answer: Depreciation, amortization, and employee benefits expense

quizzes.question: An asset has a carrying amount of N500,000 and a tax base of N400,000. If the income tax rate is 30%, what is the deferred tax position?
Which enhancing qualitative characteristic enables financial statement users to identify and understand similarities in, and differences among, items across different entities or periods?
Under the Nigerian legal framework for corporate financial reporting, which of the following is a legal requirement for published financial statements?
options: Publishing in at least 2 national dailies and signed by a director with an FRC registration number
Publishing in at least 1 international journal and signed by an external auditor only
Filing exclusively with the Stock Exchange without public daily newspaper release
Publishing quarterly in at least 3 national dailies without an FRC registration number
quizzes.correct_answer: Publishing in at least 2 national dailies and signed by a director with an FRC registration number

quizzes.question: A company in severe financial distress is preparing accounts to 31 December on a Break-up Basis. A building carried at N1,500,000 can only be sold for N1,200,000. How should this building be presented?
options: Re-measured at N1,200,000 as a current asset
Kept at N1,500,000 as a non-current asset with a note disclosure
Re-measured at N1,200,000 as a non-current asset
Written off completely to N0 as an extraordinary item
quizzes.correct_answer: Re-measured at N1,200,000 as a current asset

quizzes.question: MCPAPA Ltd sells goods to Bola Ltd for N10,000 and agrees to repurchase them in 12 months for N11,000. Applying substance over form, how should MCPAPA Ltd record this transaction?
options: Treat the transaction as a secured loan of N10,000 and accrue N1,000 interest expense
Record an outright sale of N10,000 and recognize profit immediately
Record a purchase of N11,000 and eliminate inventory
Treat as a sale with a contingent asset of N1,000
quizzes.correct_answer: Treat the transaction as a secured loan of N10,000 and accrue N1,000 interest expense

quizzes.question: According to the IASB Conceptual Framework, which of the following pairs are the Fundamental Qualitative Characteristics of useful financial information?
To achieve a perfectly faithful representation in financial reports, information must possess which three characteristics?
options: Complete, Neutral, and Free from error
quizzes.correct_answer: Complete, Neutral, and Free from error

quizzes.question: An entity breaches a covenant under a long-term loan agreement before the reporting date, making it payable on demand. After the reporting date but before authorization, the lender agrees not to demand payment. How is the loan classified?
Financial information is relevant if it has predictive or confirmatory value. Which entity-specific aspect directly impacts relevance?
Under the revised IASB Conceptual Framework, how is an Asset defined?
options: A present economic resource controlled by the entity as a result of past events
A physical property owned legally by the company giving rise to revenue
A future cash inflow that is guaranteed by a contractual arrangement
A residual interest in the assets of the entity after deducting all liabilities
quizzes.correct_answer: A present economic resource controlled by the entity as a result of past events

quizzes.question: Value in use for assets and fulfillment value for liabilities are examples of which measurement basis?
Under the physical concept of capital maintenance, when is profit earned during an accounting period?
options: Only after the physical productive capacity at the end of the period exceeds that at the start
When nominal monetary net assets at the end of the period exceed those at the start
When constant purchasing power of equity increases over general inflation
Whenever gross profit exceeds operating costs regardless of asset replacement
quizzes.correct_answer: Only after the physical productive capacity at the end of the period exceeds that at the start

quizzes.question: Joe Co buys 100 T-shirts in January for N3.50 each in cash. During January, 30 T-shirts are sold for cash at N7.00 each. What is the profit for January under the Accrual Basis?
Which user group specifically requires financial statements to assess risk and return on investment and the entity's ability to pay dividends?
In financial accounting, derecognition of a financial asset normally occurs when which condition is satisfied?
options: The entity loses control of all or part of the recognized asset
The carrying amount of the asset exceeds its recoverable amount
The asset is revalued upward using current market values
The legal title is temporarily transferred as security for a loan
quizzes.correct_answer: The entity loses control of all or part of the recognized asset

quizzes.question: Which of the following qualitative characteristics is classified as an Enhancing Qualitative Characteristic under the Conceptual Framework?
According to the IASB Framework, what does the application of Prudence involve when preparing financial statements?
options: Exercising caution when making judgements under conditions of uncertainty
Creating hidden reserves to cushion against future economic downturns
Deliberately understating assets and overstating liabilities
Recognizing profits before they are realized to maintain share value
quizzes.correct_answer: Exercising caution when making judgements under conditions of uncertainty

quizzes.question: Under Section 143(2) of the 1999 Constitution of Nigeria (as amended), what is the required vote threshold in each House of the National Assembly to pass a motion to investigate allegations of gross misconduct against the President?
options: Two-thirds majority of all members of each House
Two-thirds majority of members present and voting
Simple majority of all members of each House
Three-fifths majority of all members of each House
quizzes.correct_answer: Two-thirds majority of all members of each House

quizzes.question: Pursuant to Section 9(3) of the 1999 Constitution of Nigeria, which strict voting threshold in the National Assembly is required to alter Chapter IV (Fundamental Rights)?
options: Four-fifths majority of all members of each House
Two-thirds majority of all members of each House
Three-quarters majority of present members of each House
Simple majority of all members of the Joint National Assembly
quizzes.correct_answer: Four-fifths majority of all members of each House

quizzes.question: Under Section 232 of the 1999 Constitution of Nigeria (as amended), the Supreme Court exercises original jurisdiction to the exclusion of any other court primarily in which scenario?
options: Disputes between the Federation and a State, or between States involving a legal right
Disputes between a State Governor and the State House of Assembly
Electoral petitions arising directly from Presidential elections
Civil suits alleging fundamental human rights breaches against the Federal Government
quizzes.correct_answer: Disputes between the Federation and a State, or between States involving a legal right

quizzes.question: Under Section 9(3) of the 1999 Constitution of Nigeria (as amended), what voting threshold in each House of the National Assembly is required to pass an amendment to Chapter IV regarding Fundamental Rights?
options: Simple majority of members present and voting
Three-quarters majority of a joint sitting

quizzes.question: Which of the following matters falls strictly under the Exclusive Legislative List in Part I of the Second Schedule to the 1999 Constitution of Nigeria?
options: Electric power generation off the national grid

quizzes.question: Under Section 143 of the 1999 Constitution of Nigeria, who is empowered to appoint the seven-person panel to investigate allegations of gross misconduct against the President?
options: The Speaker of the House of Representatives
